Learning R for Journalism
I use R (specifically ggplot2 and Base R) to explore data distributions and relationships between variables. Data downloaded from Kaggle.
In [ ]:
library(readxl)
In [ ]:
exams <- read_excel("/content/exams.xlsx")
str(exams) # structure

tibble [1,000 × 8] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
 $ gender     : chr [1:1000] "female" "male" "male" "female" ...
 $ race       : chr [1:1000] "group D" "group C" "group A" "group D" ...
 $ par.edu    : chr [1:1000] "some college" "some high school" "some high school" "some high school" ...
 $ lunch      : chr [1:1000] "free/reduced" "standard" "standard" "standard" ...
 $ prep.course: chr [1:1000] "none" "none" "none" "none" ...
 $ math       : num [1:1000] 60 41 43 58 76 62 69 89 87 79 ...
 $ reading    : num [1:1000] 67 25 23 63 68 75 73 85 91 69 ...
 $ writing    : num [1:1000] 63 27 26 62 77 72 78 75 90 61 ...

In [ ]:
hist(exams$math, breaks=seq(20,100,8),ylim=c(0,210))

# text position , Let (x,y) = (h$mids,h$counts)

text(h$mids,h$counts,labels=h$counts, adj=c(0.5, -0.5)) #h$mids：柱狀圖每個值得中心點（Ｘ軸上） #h$counts是每個y軸的數量 #adj=c(0.5, -0.5))決定標籤對齊方式，前面的是水平置中對齊，後面的是向上偏移
In [ ]:
h=hist(exams$math, breaks=seq(20,100,8),freq=F,ylim=c(0,0.026))。#freq=F（或 freq=FALSE）：將直方圖從「頻數（數據個數）」改為「機率密度」，把y軸從多少個據點改成機率密度
text(h$mids,h$density,labels=round(h$density,3), adj=c(0.5, -0.5),cex=0.8)  #h$density：只取機率密度為y值 #labels=round:四捨五入到小數點第三位

lines(density(exams$math)) #line就是加上線條，讓他出現兩種視覺化功能

Construct histograms of the three exam scores:

In [ ]:
hist(exams$math, breaks=seq(20,100,8),ylim=c(0,210))
#lines(density(exams$math))
hist(exams$reading, breaks=seq(20,100,8),ylim=c(0,210),add=T)
#lines(density(exams$reading))
hist(exams$writing, breaks=seq(20,100,8),ylim=c(0,210),add=T)
#lines(density(exams$writing))
In [ ]:
colors <- c("#66c2a5", "#fc8d62", "#8da0cb") #先定義要什麼顏色！！

hist(exams$math,
     breaks = seq(20, 100, 8),    #數字幾到幾之間，間隔為八
     ylim = c(0, 210),             #y軸是210
     col = colors[1],             #選第一個顏色
     xlab = "Scores",            #x軸標籤為
     ylab = "Frequency",         #y軸標籤為
     main = "Distributions of Math, Reading, and Writing Scores",         #標題
     border = "white")       #要用白色的邊框

# add = TRUE

hist(exams$reading,
     breaks = seq(20, 100, 8),
     ylim = c(0, 210),
     col = colors[2],
     border = "white",
     add = TRUE)。       #上面都一模一樣，只是顏色什麼的有變化，然後最後一定要add = TRUE，因為是要把數值疊加在原本的圖上面

hist(exams$writing,
     breaks = seq(20, 100, 8),
     ylim = c(0, 210),
     col = colors[3],
     border = "white",
     add = TRUE)

legend("topright",                                   #legend加圖例！！   # 設定圖例外框樣式（1 = 有框線）
       legend = c("Math", "Reading", "Writing"),
       fill = colors,
       title = "Subjects",
       box.lty = 1)         # 設定圖例外框樣式（1 = 有框線）

       # box.lty = 0

Basic of ggplot2: Bar charts

In [ ]:
library(ggplot2)

p1 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = race))。#x軸為race的個數，geom_bar()為加總所有race的個數並且會製成chart
p1 + geom_bar()
In [ ]:
# create formula : after_stat

p2 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = race, y = after_stat(1/sum(count))))
p2+geom_bar()
In [ ]:
p2 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = race, y = after_stat(count/sum(count))))

p2+geom_bar()+ ylab("Proportions") # proportion
In [ ]:
p2 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = race, y = after_stat(count/sum(count))))

p2 +
  geom_bar(stat = "count", fill = c("skyblue", "pink", "lightgreen", "orange", "purple")) +
  ylab("Proportions") +
  labs(title = "Proportions of Race Categories")+
  theme_minimal()
In [ ]:
p3 <- ggplot(exams,aes(x = race, y = after_stat(count/sum(count)),fill=gender))
p3+geom_bar()
In [ ]:
# dodge2

p3+geom_bar(position = "dodge2")
In [ ]:
# dodge

p3+geom_bar(position = "dodge")
In [ ]:
# default : stack
p3+geom_bar(position = "stack")
In [ ]:
p3+geom_bar(position = "identity")
In [ ]:
# identity with alpha = 0.5 並列的 female and male)

p3+geom_bar(position = "identity",alpha = 0.5)
In [ ]:
pp1 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = math))
pp1 + geom_histogram() # bins = 30

`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.
In [ ]:
ppl <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = math)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Math Scores", x = "Math Scores", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
print(ppl)
In [ ]:
pp1 + ggtitle("K=20") +
      geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),color="blue",fill="white", bins=20)+
      theme_light()

Study the association between a continuous variable and a discrete variable

Comparing the distribution of a continuous variable of multiple groups: Exam VS lunch

In [ ]:
ggplot(exams, aes(x = math, fill=lunch))+geom_histogram(alpha=0.5)

`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

ggplot(exams, aes(x = math, fill=lunch))+geom_histogram(alpha=0.5, position="identity")

`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

  geom_histogram(position="identity", alpha=0.5)

`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

Line plot for time series data

Day.Number=1:17
Earnings=c(35, 30,25,9,10,10,10,22,23,13,3,3,3,2,9,9,6)
har.pot=data.frame(Day.Number, Earnings)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(har.pot,aes(x=Day.Number, y=Earnings)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()
